2ba8b28535a06d8e9455.headline: I-SA yamukela isinqumo se-ICJ sokuthi iMyanmar inecala lokubulala isizwe
2ba8b28535a06d8e9455.dek: Inkantolo iyalele iMyanmar ukuthi inikeze izisulu zaseRohingya isinxephezelo futhi iqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kungenzeki futhi.
2ba8b28535a06d8e9455.why: Umnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Ngamazwe eNingizimu Afrika kumele uhlolisise umthelela walesi sinqumo kumacala aqhubekayo nawesikhathi esizayoaphansi Kwesivumelwano Sokubulawa Kwezigidi.
paragraphs: I-Ningizimu Afrika yamukela isinqumo senkantolo yamazwe ngamazwe i-ICJ mhla ziyi-19 kuNovemba 2026 esithole iMyanmar inecala lokubulala isizwe samaRohingya, okuyiqembu elincane lamaSulumane. Leli cala lathathelwa phezulu yiThe Gambia, kanti isinqumo senkantolo samavoti ayisishiyagalolunye kwabayisishiyagalolunye nesithupha sithinta umkhankaso weMyanmar wowe-2017 esifundeni saseRakhine.

Umnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Ngamazwe Nokubambisana eNingizimu Afrika uthe lesi sinqumo siyisinyathelo esikhulu esiya phambili ekutholeni ubulungiswa kwezizulu zaseRohingya. Inkantolo iyalele iMyanmar ukuthi inikeze izinxephezelo zomonakamo ongazange ulungiswe, futhi inikeze iziqinisekiso zokuthi lokhu ngeke kuphinde kwenzeke.

I-Ningizimu Afrika ithe izosifunda lesi sinqumo ihlolisise umthelela waso emthethweni wamazwe ngamazwe, kubandakanya namacala aqhubekayo nawesikhathi esizayo angaphansi Kwesivumelwano Sokubulawa Kwezigidi. Iphinde yanxusa iMyanmar ukuthi iphenye, ishushise futhi ijezise labo abanecala.

72b07dd8567aa64de799.headline: Amadolobha ase-SA abeka imingcele yamanzi njengoba u-El Niño eqina
72b07dd8567aa64de799.dek: Isikhungo sase-US sokuBikezelwa Kwesimo Sezulu sithi amathuba okuba nesimo esinamandla kakhulu kuJanuwari-Mashi 2027 angaphezu kuka-79%.
72b07dd8567aa64de799.why: Abasebenzisi bamanzi eNtshonalanga Kapa nasemadolobheni amathathu okukhulunywa ngawo kumele banciphise ukusebenzisa kwabo, kanti umnyango ubika amazinga amadamu angaphansi kuka-90% eNtshonalanga Kapa naseKwaZulu-Natali.
paragraphs: ISithwane, iJohannesburg kanye neKapa sekubeke imingcele yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba u-El Niño eqina, kanti iNtshonalanga Kapa nayo ibhekene nemingcele efanayo. Le mingcele ilandela ukunxusa kukaNgqongqoshe Wezolimo uWillie Aucamp ngenyanga edlule ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqala ukubhekana nalesi simo sezulu.

Isikhungo sase-US sokuBikezelwa Kwesimo Sezulu sithe embikweni esiwukhiphe ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto ukuthi u-El Niño onamandla kakhulu kungenzeka uqhubeke kuze kube uJanuwari-Mashi 2027, kanti amathuba ahlala engaphezu kuka-79%. Umbiko uthe lesi simo sizandisa izinkinga zamanzi emadolobheni ezibangelwa ukungagcinwa kahle kwengqalasizinda ebalulekile.

Amazinga amadamu ahlala angaphezu kuka-90% kuzo zonke izifundazwe ngaphandle kweNtshonalanga Kapa naseKwaZulu-Natali, ngokusho kombiko wamasonto onke woMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuthuthwa Kwezinto; izifundazwe ezinhlanu zingaphezu kwamazinga azo ngesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule. Ndaba le ithi kukhona uxhaso lwezimali olungangezigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-10 zamarandi olutholakalayo ukubhekana nale nkinga.

2d6a066e23b06c6d97df.headline: UHill-Lewis uqala ihlandla lesibili njengemeya yaseKapa
2d6a066e23b06c6d97df.dek: I-Democratic Alliance igcine iningi layo elibonakalayo kuphela kumasipala waseNingizimu Afrika lapho iqembu linye liwine khona ukulawula, njengoba ebeka phambili izinto ezinhlanu.
2d6a066e23b06c6d97df.why: Izakhamizi zaseKapa zizothemba abaphathi bamasipala ukuthi baqhubekisele phambili ezamaphoyisa, izindlu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezidingo phakathi nalesikhathi seminyaka emihlanu sikaHill-Lewis.
paragraphs: UGeordin Hill-Lewis ufunzwe isifungo sehlandla lesibili njengemeya yaseKapa ngoLwesine, mhla ziyi-19 kuNovemba, emhlanganweni wokuqala womkhandlu kamasipala. I-Democratic Alliance (DA) igcine iningi elibonakalayo okhethweni lukamasipala wowe-2026, okwenza iKapa laba ngumasipala kuphela waseNingizimu Afrika lapho iqembu elilodwa liwine khona.

UHill-Lewis uthe uzogxila emaphoyiseni aqinile, emisebenzi, ezidingweni ezinokwethenjelwa ezingabizi, ezindlini kanye nasemadolobheni ahlanzekile. Izinhlelo zakhe zibandakanya ukwakha iyunithi yophenyo kamasipala, ukutshala imali kwezobuchwepheshe bokulwa nobugebengu, ukunciphisa ukuchitheka kwendle kanye nokukhulula umhlaba kamasipala wezindlu. Uphinde wathembisa ukufuna amandla amakhulu ophenyo amaphoyisa kamasipala.

UXanthea Limberg ukhethelwe ubusemephu wamasekeni, kanti uFelicity Purchase uhlale njengoSomlomo. Amaqembu aphikisayo amukele ukuphinde kukhethwe kukaHill-Lewis kuyilapho esiza ngokuthi kube nesinyathelo sokubhekana nokungalingani, izindlu, ukungasebenzi kwabantu kanye nengqalasizinda, futhi ecela ukuthi abeke phambili iKapa ngaphambi kwezinhloso zezepolitiki kazwelonke.

59da5352cb0b6e932db0.headline: IJohannesburg yandisausesho lomfana oneminyaka engu-11 okhukhuleke ezikhukhuleni zaseSoweto
59da5352cb0b6e932db0.dek: Amaqembu asesha kusuka enqulwini yezibi ngamamitha angaba ngu-4 emahleni, namaphoyisa ezinja, abatshuza kanye namalungu omphakathi abamba iqhaza kulo msebenzi.
59da5352cb0b6e932db0.why: Amaqembu okuhlenga kanye namavolontiya omphakathi eDobsonville kumele aqhubeke nokusesha phakathi kwamabhuloho amabili, namaqembu esebenza kusuka enqulwini yamamitha angaba ngu-4 emahleni.
paragraphs: Amaqembu okuhlenga aseJohannesburg andise usesho lwawo ngoLwesine luka-Anqobile Jiyela, umfana oneminyaka engu-11 okhukhuleke amanzi ezikhukhula eSoweto ntambama ngoLwesibili. Usesho luqale kabusha eDobsonville Extension 3 emuva kokuthi isimo sezulu esibi simisiwe ngoLwesithathu.

Okhulumela uPhiko Lwezimo Eziphuthumayo Zezokwelapha uRobert Mulaudzi uthe amaqembu ayasebenza kusuka enqulwini yezibi ngamamitha angaba ngu-4 emahleni aye lapho u-Anqobile angene khona emanzini, kanye nokuhlola iziteshi zamanzi eziseduze. Amaqembu amabili amaphoyisa ezinja, amaqembu amabili ochwepheshe bezokuhlenga, abatshuza kanye namalungu omphakathi babambe iqhaza kulo msebenzi, ohlanganisa indawo ephakathi kwamabhuloho amabili.

Indiza enophephela emhlathini yamaphoyisa isize ngomsebenzi wamadrone, kanti amaqembu asuse imihlanga ukuthuthukisa ukungena. UMulaudzi utshele i-eNCA ukuthi amaqembu ahlele ukusebenzisa amaphetshana nemimese ngoLwesihlanu ukususa imihlanga eyengeziwe futhi angene endaweni eqondiwe.

e4375d5d85cd3c8835c7.headline: Ibhange LaseNingizimu Afrika ligcina i-repo rate ku-7.25%
e4375d5d85cd3c8835c7.dek: Lesi sinqumo sigcina inzalo yokuqala isemazingeni ka-10.75%, yize amalungu ayisikhombisa ekomiti amathathu ayefuna ukukhuphuka kwamaphuzu ayi-25.
e4375d5d85cd3c8835c7.why: Imindeni eneziboleko zendlu ezihlobene nenzalo yokuqala, ezezimoto kanye nezivumelwano zesikweletu igcina izinga lika-10.75%, kodwa ayitholi sinciphiso ezinkokhelweni zazo.
paragraphs: Ibhange LaseNingizimu Afrika ligcine i-repo rate yalo ku-7.25% emhlanganweni wokugcina weKomiti Yezinqumo Zezezimali wowe-2026 ngoLwesine, lishiya inzalo yokuqala yeziboleko ku-10.75%. Lesi sinqumo sisho ukuthi akusekho ukukhuphuka kwenzalo kwabalethe ziboleko ezihlobene nezinga lokuqala.

Amalungu amane ekomiti avotele ukugcina amazinga, kanti amathathu afuna ukukhuphuka kwamaphuzu ayi-25. UM governador uLesetja Kganyago uthe ibhange lime kancane “okwamanje” kodwa lihlala lilungele ukukhuphuka kwenzalo uma izinga lokwenyuka kwamanani lizidinga. Ukwenyuka kwamanani kukhuphukile kwaba u-5.2% ngo-Okthoba kusuka ku-4.5% ngoSeptemba, phezu kwelitshe lebhange lika-3%; ibhange lilindela ukuthi lihlale lingaphezulu kuka-5% kuze kube uqala u-2027, ikakhulu ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu zikaphethroli.
Ukubanjwa nakho akulethi mpumuzo entsha yokunciphiswa kwenzalo. Isinyathelo esilandelayo sebhange sizoxhomeka ekwenyukeni kwamanani, izintengo kaphethroli, irandi kanye nezimo zomnotho ezibanzi.
